explanation: The value is 0 everywhere except at GO steps that come right after two or more unrewarded trials in a row. These GO steps sit mostly early in the episode (about trials 1 to 25, and the very first trial) and reach 5 to 10, highest (10) on the second or third loss in a row, especially when the agent switches its choice; a single loss after a reward gives 0, and the same loss streaks later in the episode give only 0 to 3, rarely up to 6.
